is_anopheles.evidence: The paper studies Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions that a concurrent entomological survey (Yovogan et al., 2021) reported the L1014F kdr mutation (page 2, page 5), but this paper itself does not report any new genotype data for these markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype counts or frequencies for insecticide resistance markers.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in three districts in southern Benin (page 1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study of malaria burden and risk factors.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in three districts (Cove, Zagnanado, and Ouinhi) in southern Benin (page 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The survey was conducted between October and November 2019 (page 1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new cross-sectional survey.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is needed.

assessment.summary: This paper reports on a community-based cross-sectional survey of malaria burden and risk factors in southern Benin. While it mentions that a concurrent entomological study (Yovogan et al., 2021) found high levels of pyrethroid resistance and the L1014F kdr mutation, this paper does not present any primary genotype data itself.
